flags.message: Salience version mismatch: metrics/statpack.md's 'Segment base rate by salience band' table is headed sal-v8, while record/context.json carries salience_version sal-v9. I anchored on the frozen cert_anchor.rate (0.731, federal band, which is also this caption class's floor) rather than on the table, and read the table's federal column only for shape.

Paper-only docket (Rule 34.6) with the United States as petitioner, but no government petition was staged under record/documents/, so the questions presented were not read and same-question.json has petitions: null. The forecast rests on the docket, public case history, and the Oct 1, 2026 grant in the lead case No. 26-104 (Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha), which the record does not link to this docket.
